About
Cookies are small text files that can be used by websites to make a user's experience more efficient.

The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

Learn more about who we are, how you can contact us and how we process personal data in our Privacy Policy.

Perks and Benefits

At Svitla, we are dedicated to creating a supportive environment that not only fuels professional growth but also ensures a healthy work-life balance, allowing our team to thrive in both their careers and personal lives.

1.

Projects & Compensation

  • US and EU projects based on advanced technologies.
  • Competitive compensation plan that takes skills and experience into consideration.
  • Regular performance appraisals to support your growth.
2.

Wellbeing & Care

  • Comprehensive private healthcare support.
  • Sport reimbursement for onsite and online activities.
  • Paid time off for vacations, national holidays, and sick leaves.
3.

Remote Friendly Culture

  • Well-established remote culture and flexible working hours.
  • Simple processes, no micromanagement, efficient communication.
  • Enjoyable work-life balance, adjustable to your preferences.
4.

Education

  • Personalized learning program tailored to your interests and skill development.
  • Free tech webinars and meetups organized by Svitla.
  • Bonuses for speakers, writers, and active community participants.
5.

Offices

  • Welcoming, spacious offices with modern facilities
  • Plenty of snacks, frequent office lunches, and meetups.
6.

Corporate Events & Gifts

  • Frequent corporate online\offline celebrations and activities.
  • Active volunteer community.
  • Welcome and anniversary presents, gifts for children, and more.

Our Approach

1.
Empowering Growth
90% of the Svitla Team consists of senior-level developers, highly proficient, self-driven, and capable of setting mindful goals and consistently pursuing them. To support their development, we cover individual learning programs, bonuses for certifications and other activities.
2.
High-Tech Global Projects
Our projects come mainly from the US and EU, allowing us to utilize the latest technologies. At Svitla, developers work directly with clients’ teams and are fully integrated into their processes. This approach helps them make a personal impact on cutting-edge products and build lasting, successful partnerships.
3.
Work-Life Flexibility
Founded as a remote-friendly company 20 years ago, flexibility in workspace, schedule, and the pursuit of meaningful work have naturally become our core values. With us, you can enjoy a work-life balance adjustable to your preferences.
4.
Simple Processes
At Svitla, all our processes are designed with one goal: to make everyone's experience pleasant and efficient. We trust our teammates, favor their autonomy, and avoid micromanagement. We excel in building efficient communication among our distributed teams and continually seek new ways to stay connected.
